existingCoverageAndGap: Prior Core/installed-SDK/Web signed-continuation controls did not exercise actual Google/Vertex print/JSON restart or RPC physical switches/edit. Extend the existing built-in Anthropic transport/tool fixture, preserving its seventy cases and deadlines, rather than creating a provider or framework.
coverage: Six new scenarios, 24 native SSE requests per successful focused/root execution: print and JSON each use three requests per provider; each RPC uses five prompts/six requests. Ten real emitted CLI processes total, with one echo effect per journey. Transport-origin-only interception retains built-in construction, native metadata, request lowering, hooks, redaction, tool/final publication and persistence. The trusted extension registers only continuation_echo.

Google API-key and supplied Vertex Bearer configuration are real CLI environment composition. Native path/header assertions distinguish Google v1beta from the Vertex regional project path. Both journeys begin at gemini-3.8-flash; requested model and physical provider/API bind stored provenance, independently of response modelVersion aliases. This is not ADC/issuer/refresh or account authentication.

Print and JSON exit and restart with explicit same --model/--session-id/--session-dir. Ordered private 0600 v2 journal entries retain signed text/thought/tool and empty signed text/thought blocks. Native requests replay both prior assistants and the paired tool result; only one echo effect occurs across each restart.

SSE thought fragments retain the last nonempty signature. A disposable configured credential deliberately equals a text signature: the journal retains [REDACTED], native replay omits that ineligible base64 field, and valid later signatures survive. Synthetic opaque values are not vendor signatures or cryptographic authentication.

RPC waits genuine agent_settled before each durable read or next prompt. It covers same-owner replay, same-provider model 3.8 to 2.5 projection with target-specific omitted function-call IDs, coupled Google/Vertex provider-plus-API switches, return to owner and target-only context replacement. These are not independent API-only host switches; unchanged Core cases supply that distinct lower-layer boundary.

Target editing replaces selected text and removes selected reasoning/text signatures while preserving its unchanged tool call/signature, later owner signatures and original raw assistant rows. Intervening foreign-model/provider reasoning stays text without opaque fields on owner replay; no global invalidation or secure-erasure claim.
Live JSON exact content is existing aggregated text/thinking/toolCall without opaque data or empty-reasoning placeholders, not ordered native replay. No public protocol change.

Focused 331: 76 emitted process cases (70 retained Anthropic/six new), 251 unchanged Core Google-profile cases, four unchanged emitted context-state host cases. Five unchanged browser cases are regression evidence only, not new UI gestures, visual or built-in Web qualification.
